decisions.reason: Key rule 3.5: for a publisher URL, the key is 'the DOI from the /doi/ path segment', null only 'when you cannot tell where it ends'. Here one can tell: the same hand-written bibliography entry carries {{Doi|10.1111/0004-5608.00043}}, and the trailing '/abstract' is the Wiley page-view route after the DOI, not part of the identifier. The locked key 10.1111/0004-5608.00043 is right; the engine's key including '/abstract' is not the DOI.
